cases.title: 显式力矩与有界隐式PD：相同力限下的正反饱和响应
limitations: Saturated branch only; does not calibrate unsaturated PD tracking, effort limit transitions or multi-DoF joints
PADMM CPU, single revolute, no gravity/contact/armature
Internal arrays are instrumentation, not a supported application API
Bounded-PD terminal convergence stayed false under the frozen 1e-7 tolerances and 200-iteration budget; terminal status was diagnostic, not an acceptance gate. No thresholds were relaxed.
cases.observation: 两种驱动路径均把正反请求限制为 ±1 N·m，转角/角速度吻合独立有效惯量参考。显式路径 terminal converged=100%；有界隐式PD在冻结的1e-7容差下为0%，到达200迭代预算。物理验收通过不等于该收敛标志通过。

cases.title: 有历史求解器默认reset与全新求解器的同初态重放
limitations: Tests default ResetConfig but explicitly uses internal warmstarting, not all warmstart modes
Status is recorded but exact iteration-count equality is not a physical criterion
Bounded-PD terminal convergence stayed false under the frozen 1e-7 tolerances and 200-iteration budget; terminal status was diagnostic, not an acceptance gate. No thresholds were relaxed.
cases.observation: 形成非零运动和乘子历史后，所测reset模式与fresh参考的重放、独立进程重复在保存数组中一致；Control保持不变且重放前显式重发命令。有界PD terminal converged=0%，reset和物理一致性通过不构成求解收敛保证。

limitations: Preserve assumes supplied body states are consistent; no projection of invalid states is claimed
